title: Junior Flutter Developer
description:
We are looking for a motivated **Junior Flutter Developer** to join our development team and work on real\-world mobile application projects.

Job Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**
* Convert UI/UX designs from Figma into responsive Flutter interfaces
* Integrate REST APIs and backend services
* Work with Laravel\-based APIs and databases
* Implement authentication, notifications, payment gateways, and other app features
* Debug, test, and fix application issues
* Optimize applications for performance and usability
* Work closely with senior developers, designers, and project managers
* Publish and maintain applications on Google Play Store and App Store
* Learn and adopt new Flutter/mobile development technologies

Requirements

* Basic to good knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**
* Understanding of mobile application development concepts
* Knowledge of REST API integration
* Basic knowledge of JSON and HTTP APIs
* Understanding of Git/GitHub
* Familiarity with Firebase is an advantage
* Basic knowledge of Android development and Play Store deployment is a plus
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills
* Willingness to learn and work on different types of projects

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: Up to ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: iOS Developer Intern
description:
